description:
The plot illustrates the loss values for two experiments (Ex1 and Ex2) across training steps, showing both training loss and validation loss for each. The x-axis is labeled “Step” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60000, with tick labels at intervals of 10000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 1.1 x 10<sup>0</sup> to 1.2 x 10<sup>1</sup>, with tick labels at intervals of 10<sup>0</sup>. 

The first line, representing “Ex1 Loss”, is blue, uses circular markers, and is solid. It begins at a value of approximately 1.1 x 10<sup>1</sup> at a step of 0, decreases to approximately 2.0 x 10<sup>0</sup> at a step of 10000, and then remains relatively steady, fluctuating between approximately 1.8 x 10<sup>0</sup> and 2.2 x 10<sup>0</sup> until a step of 60000, where it ends at approximately 1.9 x 10<sup>0</sup>. The second line, representing “Ex2 Loss”, is gray, uses circular markers, and is solid. It starts at approximately 3.0 x 10<sup>0</sup> at a step of 0, decreases to approximately 2.3 x 10<sup>0</sup> at a step of 10000, and then declines to approximately 1.8 x 10<sup>0</sup> at a step of 60000. The third line, representing “Ex1 Validation Loss”, is blue, uses diamond markers, and is dashed. It begins at approximately 5.0 x 10<sup>0</sup> at a step of 0, decreases to approximately 3.2 x 10<sup>0</sup> at a step of 10000, and then remains relatively steady, fluctuating between approximately 3.0 x 10<sup>0</sup> and 3.4 x 10<sup>0</sup> until a step of 60000, where it ends at approximately 3.1 x 10<sup>0</sup>. The fourth line, representing “Ex2 Validation Loss”, is teal, uses diamond markers, and is dashed. It starts at approximately 1.1 x 10<sup>1</sup> at a step of 0, decreases to approximately 4.5 x 10<sup>0</sup> at a step of 10000, and then declines to approximately 3.5 x 10<sup>0</sup> at a step of 60000.
